questions.cardText:
[Theater] What is method acting?
A. A technique where actors strictly follow the script without any improvisation
B. A method where actors use makeup and costumes to enhance their performance
C. A way of acting where actors draw on their own emotions and experiences
Answer: C. Method acting encourages performers to deeply immerse themselves in their roles to create a realistic portrayal of their character, sometimes staying in character even off-camera to maintain authenticity.
questions.de: Wie heißt die Schauspieltechnik, bei der Darsteller auf eigene Gefühle und Erfahrungen zurückgreifen, um ganz in ihre Rolle einzutauchen – manchmal bleiben sie sogar abseits der Kamera in der Rolle?
questions.en: What is the name of the acting technique in which performers draw on their own emotions and experiences to immerse themselves in a role, sometimes staying in character even off-camera?

timeline.labelEn: Lee Strasberg co-founds the Group Theatre in New York, where he develops 'the Method' from Stanislavski's system
timeline.labelDe: Lee Strasberg gründet in New York das Group Theatre mit und entwickelt dort aus Stanislawskis System „die Methode“

questions.notes: Accept 'the Method'. German also 'Method Acting' or 'die Methode' (Strasberg).

questions.cardText:
[Art History] Which of the following schools of art is Pablo Picasso known for co-founding?
A. Impressionism
B. Expressionism
C. Cubism
Answer: C.
questions.de: Welche Kunstrichtung begründete Pablo Picasso gemeinsam mit Georges Braque?
questions.en: Which art movement did Pablo Picasso pioneer together with Georges Braque?

timeline.labelEn: Picasso and Braque develop Cubism in Paris, from its beginnings to the outbreak of the First World War
timeline.labelDe: Picasso und Braque entwickeln in Paris den Kubismus – von den Anfängen bis zum Ausbruch des Ersten Weltkriegs

questions.notes: Wikipedia: the movement was pioneered in partnership by Picasso and Braque; Cooper dates Early Cubism 1906–1908, High Cubism 1909–1914.
